verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no first-party capability for the assistant to drive a real browser by navigating, logging in, clicking, and extracting from live pages. The closest items fall outside the story: agentic web search that lets models 'follow links autonomously', MCP client support that could plug in external tools, Open Terminal code execution, and Open WebUI Computer serving browser tabs to a user. None of these documents assistant-controlled browser automation, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power user, the assistant can drive a real browser — navigate, log in, click, and extract from live pages on my behalf
